definitions.servo_command_deg: Absolute servo g command angle. The LUT maps the commanded angle, not the ideal driven-gear angle.
definitions.optical_offset_deg: Signed camera-ray angle of the calibrated gripper-centre marker in the arm motion plane; camera optical axis is zero and image-down is positive.
definitions.inferred_servo_angle_deg: The g-equivalent command angle inferred by inverting this lookup table; this is not direct HX8 encoder telemetry.

runtime_anchor.detector: HSV red-circle detector for calibration and validation; V9 foam segmentation for marker-free automatic operation
runtime_anchor.requirement: The red marker represented the gripper centre only while measuring this table. Remove it for normal operation, detect the external target centre, convert that pixel to optical_offset_deg, and invert this table to obtain the servo g command.

mechanical_transmission.note: Do not apply the 40:48 gear ratio again at runtime.

fit.method: Per-command median red-marker bearing with 20 edge frames trimmed, averaged across outbound and return holds; the -100 degree turnaround has one hold.
fit.absolute_accuracy_note: Validation measures the repeatability and interpolation accuracy of the camera/servo system. It is not an externally traceable protractor measurement of the driven link's absolute mechanical angle.

source.exclusion_reason: After the mechanical slip, the marker was outside the useful image region at -40 and -35 degrees. V3 is intentionally limited to the fully observed -100 to -45 degree range.
source.recalibration_reason: The mechanism slipped after an unintended motion into its physical limit, changing the servo-command to optical-bearing relation.
